description: Lists every live Collector Crypt graded-card pack with price, category, chance of each rarity, card value range per rarity, buyback rate, average value per dollar and popularity (pulls in the last 7 days), most popular first. Use it first to compare packs or to find a pack code; use get_pack for one pack's top cards and cards left, and search_cards to look for a specific card. Read-only, no sign-in; numbers are Collector Crypt's live mainnet data, at most 5 minutes old.

category.description: Only packs of this category. 'Others' covers Lorcana, Riftbound, Dragon Ball and anime. Leave out for all packs.

name: list_packs

buyback_pct.description: Share of a card's insured value paid if sold back within 72 hours.

odds_pct.description: Chance per pack of each rarity, in percent.

value_range_usd.description: Card value range per rarity as [low, high] in US$.

title: List the packs
